name: Child Support Caseload and Collections
description:
This dataset contains child support program performance data organized by indicator, case type, and date. Each row pairs a measure—such as total cases with orders, support establishment percentage, percentage of cases with a collection, current distributed percentage, or calendar year collections—with a case category (Total, Current, Former, Never, or Yearly Goal) and a reporting date. Depending on the indicator, the corresponding value appears in one of three numeric fields: caseload (counts of cases), percentage (rates and shares), or dollars (collection amounts). Because each row uses only the field relevant to its indicator, the numeric columns are largely empty by design.

The data can be used to track child support caseloads and collection outcomes over time, compare performance across case types, monitor progress toward yearly goals, and benchmark establishment and collection rates. Analysts could build trend reports, dashboards, or performance scorecards, and agencies could use the figures to assess program effectiveness and identify where case categories
